name: The Lenspire
description:
WE ARE THE WEDDING ARCHITECTS, WHO BELIEVE IN CREATING UNFORGETTABLE MEMORIES…!!!

ABOUT US

I'm Sandeep Jadhav and I'd love to be your photographer! I specialize in family and wedding photography. I am doing what I love for a living. I shoot with a Sony Alpha A7III, and mainly use Prime Lenses. My favorite types of photographs are ones filled with real emotion - Crying, Laughter, Passion, I want to capture it all! I want you to look back at your photos 10 years from now and smile from ear to ear. In my spare time I love to explore new places, I invest a lot of time into each and every couple/family that I photograph. I want to get to know you and really capture something that shows who you are.

featured_reviews.name: reshma mahadik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had so many of my events captured by this amazing and creative team @Samarth Creative Studio. Personally I want to thank Swapnil Deshmukh and his partner, his brother Swaplesh Deshmukh for there amazing professional skills and for catching our wedding day in a most beautiful and incredible way.

There candid photography team also worked very well. Most of the time we forgot they were taking our pictures, but they did a best job and the photos taken by them speaks a lot about them.

Be it Wedding, Baby Shower or even on Birthday, there love towards the photography and their professionalism shows through out the whole process. We enjoyed every moment of our wedding, baby shower & the first birthday of my daughter.

Best wishes to entire Samarth Creative Studio Team

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met Swapnil 13 years back and since then we are buddies. One thing i have always seen that makes him and his profession stand out is that the work that comes to him, he always grasp it as a new challenge and completes it in a unique way. As the name itself say's, Samarth Creative has always been creative and unique in it's profession of photography in wide angles of it's services.
I wish Swapnil, Swaplesh (Brother and Partner of Swapnil at Smarth Creative) and his whole team, all the very best for coming blooming years ahead.

Regards
Nitin Shinde
